note: Stand-in media is synthetic lavfi/sine only. Substitute the tester's own eligible footage using the same properties; do not commit copyrighted files.

scenarios.title: Synthetic editing fixture
scenarios.purpose: Repeatable import, insert, save, reopen, caption, and reference-export checks.
expectedEdits: Add two SRT captions covering 0–3 s and 3–6 s
scenarios.expectedDelivery: master.ffv1 reference plus optional YouTube 1080p VP9/Opus WebM
scenarios.relinkCheck: Move talking-head.mkv, reopen, Relink to the new path; asset count stays 1 and clip count stays 2 (linked video+audio from the muxed MKV).

scenarios.title: YouTube episode (stand-in)
scenarios.purpose: Short generated stand-in (12 s A-roll / 6 s B-roll) for a 10–20 minute creator workflow: A-roll, B-roll, music, captions, 16:9 delivery.
expectedEdits: Mark source In/Out on A-roll (2 s–10 s) and ripple-insert
Overlay B-roll on a second video track for 3 s at 4 s
Place music under the sequence; lower clip gain so dialogue stays readable
Add captions for the A-roll sentences
scenarios.expectedDelivery: YouTube 1080p VP9/Opus WebM; sidecar WebVTT optional
scenarios.relinkCheck: Relink A-roll after moving the file; sequence duration and caption times must not change.

scenarios.title: Two-person interview (stand-in)
scenarios.purpose: Two picture angles plus one master audio recording before multicam exists.
expectedEdits: Align both cameras and lav-master at 00:00:00:00 (manual; no multicam group yet)
Keep lav-master as the audible track; mute camera audio
Cut picture between camera A and B by trimming/splitting at 4 s and 7 s
Export podcast Opus-only plus a VP9 picture reference
scenarios.expectedDelivery: Podcast Opus WebM plus optional VP9 picture
scenarios.relinkCheck: Offline camera-b, relink; A/V offset of the remaining clips must stay zero.

scenarios.title: Short film scene (stand-in)
scenarios.purpose: 24 fps picture, production sound, titles, and a reference master.
expectedEdits: Set sequence to 1920×1080 24 fps if the first clip does not
Insert picture and production sound, linked or stacked
scenarios.relinkCheck: Copy the project folder to another path and reopen; media comes back Online or Relink reports the missing URI.
